This new tool displays the list of all objects on the map with search and filtering options. It also allows you to focus on objects in 3D viewport, to select their layer or to hide/unhide & freeze/unfreeze them. You can also save info about a set of selected objects.

This tool allows you to select objects by clicking on them or by dragging a selection box around multiple objects, without danger of accidentally displacing or rotating the selected object(s). CTRL-LeftClick on objects allows you to add or remove them from the selection, CTRL-LeftClick+Drag allows you to add multiple objects to the selection, ALT-LeftClick will remove the clicked objects from the selection, and ALT-LeftClick+Drag will remove multiple objects from the selection.
